verdict.rationale: Fern's changelog says Fern Agent can be put on a schedule. These automations recur rather than run once: they review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries or analytics, report findings, and open pull requests when the prompt asks for a change. This is a first-party scheduled workflow, though only a short changelog entry describes it. Missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule configuration (frequency/cron options, management, run history), scheduling of workflows beyond Fern Agent docs tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You can now put Fern Agent on a schedule
Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found, and open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change.
